{
  "items": [
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0202"],
      "quote": "The Council's social value policy asks every major contract to create local jobs, training and opportunities for small businesses.",
      "statement": "The Council's social value policy asks every major contract to create local jobs, training and opportunities for small businesses; this states background information.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BACKGROUND",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0203"],
      "quote": "Social value carries five percent of the evaluation, as section 13 explains.",
      "statement": "Social value carries five percent of the evaluation, as section 13 explains.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BACKGROUND",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0204"],
      "quote": "The Contractor should place at least a quarter of its subcontracted spend with small businesses based in the region.",
      "statement": "The Contractor should place at least a quarter of its subcontracted spend with small businesses based in the region.",
      "modality": "should",
      "disposition": "OPTIONAL",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0205"],
      "quote": "The Council reports the social value of its contracts each year to its cabinet.",
      "statement": "The Council reports the social value of its contracts each year to its cabinet; this binds the buyer, not the supplier.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "OUT_OF_SCOPE",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0206"],
      "quote": "In 2025 the Council's contracts created 140 apprenticeships for residents of the borough.",
      "statement": "In 2025 the Council's contracts created 140 apprenticeships for residents of the borough; this is background information.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BACKGROUND",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0207"],
      "quote": "The Council awards the contract to the most economically advantageous tender, judged on quality and price.",
      "statement": "The Council awards the contract to the most economically advantageous tender, judged on quality and price; this binds the Council.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "OUT_OF_SCOPE",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0208"],
      "quote": "Quality carries 60 percent of the total and price 40 percent.",
      "statement": "Quality carries 60 percent of the total and price 40 percent; this states background evaluation weights.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BACKGROUND",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0216"],
      "quote": "Each quality criterion is scored from 0 to 4: 0 for no response, 1 for a poor response, 2 for an acceptable response, 3 for a good response and 4 for an excellent response.",
      "statement": "Each quality criterion is scored from 0 to 4; this governs evaluator scoring rather than binding the supplier directly.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "OUT_OF_SCOPE",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0217"],
      "quote": "A score is multiplied by the criterion's weight and divided by 4.",
      "statement": "A score is multiplied by the criterion's weight and divided by 4; this outlines the evaluation process.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "OUT_OF_SCOPE",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0218"],
      "quote": "A tender that scores 0 or 1 on any quality criterion is excluded from the evaluation.",
      "statement": "A tender that scores 0 or 1 on any quality criterion is excluded from the evaluation; this outlines evaluation rules.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "OUT_OF_SCOPE",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0219"],
      "quote": "Each quality criterion corresponds to one question in the response template on the portal.",
      "statement": "Each quality criterion corresponds to one question in the response template on the portal.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BACKGROUND",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0220"],
      "quote": "Evaluators read each response against the requirements in sections 5 to 12 and in Annex B.",
      "statement": "Evaluators read each response against the requirements in sections 5 to 12 and in Annex B; this binds evaluators.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "OUT_OF_SCOPE",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0221"],
      "quote": "Price is scored by dividing the lowest total price by the bidder's total price and multiplying by 40.",
      "statement": "Price is scored by dividing the lowest total price by the bidder's total price and multiplying by 40; this governs evaluation.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "OUT_OF_SCOPE",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0222"],
      "quote": "The total price is the sum of the annual service charges for five years and the implementation charge in Annex C.",
      "statement": "The total price is the sum of the annual service charges for five years and the implementation charge in Annex C.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BACKGROUND",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0223"],
      "quote": "Three evaluators score each quality response on their own, and then agree a score at a moderation meeting.",
      "statement": "Three evaluators score each quality response on their own, and then agree a score at a moderation meeting; this binds evaluators.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "OUT_OF_SCOPE",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0224"],
      "quote": "The Council invites the two highest-scoring bidders to a presentation, which confirms the scores already given rather than adding new ones.",
      "statement": "The Council invites the two highest-scoring bidders to a presentation; this outlines the Council's evaluation process.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "OUT_OF_SCOPE",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0225"],
      "quote": "In this document, the words below have the meanings given to them. \"Council\" means Halverton Borough Council. \"Contractor\" means the bidder to which the Council awards the contract. \"Case\" means a request, application, complaint or report that the Council records and handles to a decision. \"Working Day\" means a day other than a Saturday, a Sunday or a public holiday in Halverton. \"Service Hours\" means 08:00 to 18:00 on Working Days, during which the Contractor's service desk answers calls from Council staff.",
      "statement": "Definitions are provided for terms used throughout the document.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BACKGROUND",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0226"],
      "quote": "\"Go-live\" means the first day on which a team handles new cases in the service.",
      "statement": "\"Go-live\" means the first day on which a team handles new cases in the service.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BACKGROUND",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0227"],
      "quote": "The contract uses the Council's standard terms for technology services, published on the portal with this request for proposal, with the particular terms below.",
      "statement": "The contract uses the Council's standard terms for technology services, published on the portal with this request for proposal, with the particular terms below.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BACKGROUND",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0228"],
      "quote": "The particular terms prevail over the standard terms where the two differ.",
      "statement": "The particular terms prevail over the standard terms where the two differ.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BACKGROUND",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0229"],
      "quote": "The Contractor shall accept unlimited liability for any loss of personal data caused by its breach of the contract.",
      "statement": "The Contractor accepts unlimited liability for any loss of personal data caused by its breach of the contract.",
      "modality": "shall",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0230"],
      "quote": "The Contractor shall indemnify the Council against any claim by a third party that the service infringes a patent, copyright or trade mark.",
      "statement": "The Contractor indemnifies the Council against any claim by a third party that the service infringes a patent, copyright or trade mark.",
      "modality": "shall",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0231"],
      "quote": "All intellectual property rights in the configurations, reports and documents created for the Council are owned by the Council from the moment of their creation.",
      "statement": "All intellectual property rights in the configurations, reports and documents created for the Council are owned by the Council from the moment of their creation.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BACKGROUND",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0232"],
      "quote": "The Contractor shall process personal data only on the Council's documented instructions, as the Council's data processor.",
      "statement": "The Contractor processes personal data only on the Council's documented instructions, as the Council's data processor.",
      "modality": "shall",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0233"],
      "quote": "The Council pays monthly in arrears, within 30 days of a valid invoice.",
      "statement": "The Council pays monthly in arrears, within 30 days of a valid invoice; this binds the Council.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "OUT_OF_SCOPE",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0234"],
      "quote": "Prices for years four and five change with the consumer price index published in the month before each anniversary of the contract start.",
      "statement": "Prices for years four and five change with the consumer price index published in the month before each anniversary of the contract start.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BACKGROUND",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0235"],
      "quote": "The Contractor shall keep professional indemnity insurance of at least £5,000,000 for six years after the contract ends.",
      "statement": "The Contractor keeps professional indemnity insurance of at least £5,000,000 for six years after the contract ends.",
      "modality": "shall",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0236"],
      "quote": "This annex lists optional services that a bidder can offer, each with a box to tick.",
      "statement": "This annex lists optional services that a bidder can offer, each with a box to tick.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BACKGROUND",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0237"],
      "quote": "[ ] The Contractor will provide on-site training for each team in the month after go-live (tick if offered).",
      "statement": "On-site training is an option the form leaves unticked, so nothing is required.",
      "modality": "will",
      "disposition": "NOT_BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0238"],
      "quote": "[ ] The Contractor will translate the resident portal into Polish and Urdu (tick if offered).",
      "statement": "Translating the resident portal is an option the form leaves unticked, so nothing is required.",
      "modality": "will",
      "disposition": "NOT_BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0239"],
      "quote": "The price schedule sets out the charges that make up the total price used in the evaluation.",
      "statement": "The price schedule sets out the charges that make up the total price used in the evaluation.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BACKGROUND",
      "hazard": false
    }
  ],
